from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialEquityItem(BaseModel):
    """An equity-related line item extracted from a financial document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The registrant company name found in the document")
    period_ended: str | None = Field(description="The date range the financial report covers")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The specific line item label found (e.g., 'Additional paid-in capital')")
    line_item_value: float | None = Field(description="The reported monetary value for the line item")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The unit of the reported value (e.g., 'thousands', 'millions')")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt anchoring the label and value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_equity_items: list[FinancialEquityItem]
